What is Simple Talk’s AI usage policy for contributors?

We do not allow or accept AI-generated content on Simple Talk, but contributors may use AI to assist them with spell checking, basic grammar, brainstorming ideas, creating graphics and images, and other basic tasks.
What is AI-generated content, and is it allowed on Simple Talk?
AI-generated content is anything (text, images, code, etc) created by an AI tool of any kind.
If you used an AI-based tool, generative or otherwise, to create the actual content (whether text, images, or code), it is considered “AI-generated,” even if you applied substantial edits afterward.
We do not allow AI-generated content on Simple Talk.
What is AI-assisted content, and is it allowed on Simple Talk?

AI-assisted content is content you have created yourself but used an AI tool to help edit, refine, error-check (for example, spelling and grammar), and make subtle improvements – but not substantial changes – to your content.
